item.title: Crookston Park and Rec Board to meet on Monday
item.description: The Crookston Park Board will meet on Monday, March 9 at 4:30 p.m. at the Crookston City Hall conference room. The agenda includes the Winter recap, the 15U B Tournament, pool events, an active transportation plan, and the spring/summer fun finder.

item.title: The Alluma Foundation to host Ignite the Light on April 25
item.description: The Alluma Foundation will host Ignite the Light on Saturday, April 25, 2026, at 4:30 p.m. at the Crookston Inn & Convention Center. The event will bring community members together to expand access to mental health and substance use disorder care across northwestern Minnesota. item.title: Crookston Middle School Knowledge Bowl team wins their own competition
item.description: Congratulations to the Crookston Middle School Knowledge Bowl team on winning their home knowledge bowl meet on Monday. Crookston took 1st place out of 18 teams.
